goal: Compare a boxwork hollow with the ridge beside it, then reach the contact where the boxwork meets the layered sulfate unit.
goal_short: Compare a boxwork hollow with its ridge, then reach the sulfate contact.
goal_note: This follows Curiosity's own boxwork campaign on Mount Sharp (2025-2026). The walk stays on ground the rover has already driven.

116_1944.name: Altadena
116_1944.kind: Drill site at the edge of the boxwork
116_1944.note: Curiosity prepared to drill here on sols 4561-4562 before driving deeper into what the team called a "potentially boxwork-bearing region".

119_1722.name: Monte Grande hollow
119_1722.kind: Hollow · drill target Valle de la Luna
119_1722.note: "The boxwork structures are a series of ridges and hollows." Curiosity drilled the Valle de la Luna block inside this hollow (plan for sols 4689-4694).

120_82.name: Nevado Sajama ridge
120_82.kind: Ridge top · drill target Nevado Sajama
120_82.note: Drilled on sol 4718 to compare with the hollow below: "We hope their comparison will provide us with new insights into how the boxwork unit came to be."

121_0.name: Southern contact
121_0.kind: Boxwork meets the layered sulfate unit
121_0.note: Curiosity imaged this contact on sols 4832-4837: "These will be key to helping us understand the origin and evolution of the boxwork unit."
